name: senderClass
meaning: classId of the last message sender (written for every message with a sender); Init sets 0x73. Tested for 0x73/0x18 in the drive messages.

name: contact
meaning: Collide_ResolveMove contact output for the carpet's own sweep.

name: follower
meaning: Trajectory follower (arrive radius 30, use3d 1, speed 0). pointIndex +0x64 is moved both ways by HandleMessage and Update.

name: traj
meaning: TRAJECTORY property resource {u16 count; Vec3s pts[]}; the carpet starts on pts[0].

name: rideBox
meaning: Model box 0 + pos with the top raised by 30. Objects overlapping it are carried and Sheep in it are anchored. Rebuilt only by Init and Move.

name: speed
meaning: Signed drive speed from the last message (0x47 arg, ±400 for 0x1F/0x20, 400 when returning), multiplied in place by speedRatio/100 in TrajStep. Positive values above 1200 are zeroed.

name: speedRatio
meaning: SPEEDRATIO property, a percentage (50/70 in Lvl-13, 100 in Lvl-05).

name: homePos
meaning: Position after Init (trajectory point 0); the return target in mode 4 and the Reset position.

name: snapPoint
meaning: The waypoint consumed in this TrajStep; Move snaps onto it that frame.

name: carpetFlags
meaning: RCarpetMobileFlags: 1 collide, 2 reversed, 4 clamp at ends (one-way), 8 driven this frame, 0x10 snapped to waypoint, 0x20 scratch in-radius.

name: mode
meaning: RCarpetMobileMode: 1 loop (Create default), 2 one-way, 4 one-way and return home when not driven. Set by msg 0x68 (the RollingCarpet's MOVING property) or by 0x1F/0x20 (4).
